title: Governor Kelly Armstrong declares Legal Assistant/Paralegal Day
text:
Governor Kelly Armstrong declares Legal Assistant/Paralegal Day
Governor Kelly Armstrong declared June 25 Legal Assistant/Paralegal Day, according to a June 24 announcement. Armstrong presented the official proclamation to members of the Western Dakota Association of Legal Assistants.
The event included a presentation ceremony where Armstrong was joined by association members Deyan Junker, Trisha Kinnischtzke, Megan Klym, Anna Jellesed, Melissa Hamilton, ACP; Melissa Klimpel, ACP; Ashley Miller, ACP; and Erica Norris. A photograph from the event also featured Attorney General Drew Wrigley with the group.
The proclamation recognizes the contributions of legal assistants and paralegals in North Dakota. The document can be viewed online as 'Legal Assistant & Paralegal Day - 2026.pdf'.
Armstrong's declaration highlights ongoing recognition for professionals supporting legal services in the state.
